title: Genshin Impact — Redcon (Player-POV What If?)
tts_note: Genshin ALWAYS uses Chatterbox via fal-ai/chatterbox/text-to-speech. Voice ref: assets/genshin-impact/characters/traveller/voice-1.mp3 (the Traveler's voice). Second-person monologue throughout. Long monologue (>80 words) → mandatory chunking into ≤35-word segments (see sound.md §1b).

format_overrides.note: Player-POV variant. Character = the Traveler (player). Each episode: one canonical Teyvat crisis, one cross-nation team assembled via gacha pulls, one divergence outcome made possible by a character the Traveler pulled.
format_overrides.structure: TEASER (clip 1, TTS starts) → TITLE CARD (clip 2, silent) → HOOK+CTA (clip 3) → CANON REMINDER (clip 4) → CREW ASSEMBLED (clip 5) → DIVERGENCE (clip 6) → REVELATION (clip 7) → CTA asset

voiceover_hook.template_en: Imagine, you grabbed free Primogems from the link in bio… and [outcome in one clause].
voiceover_hook.note: Must appear in clip 1. The phrase 'free Primogems from the link in bio' is the Genshin CTA hook — mandatory for attribution.

cta_clip.url_note: If cta.mp4 doesn't exist for genshin-impact, stop and notify manager — do NOT use star-trek-timelines CTA.
cta_clip.spoken_cta_en: Grab free Primogems — link in bio.
cta_clip.spoken_cta_note: Short spoken CTA embedded in clip 3 (hook). Does NOT replace the cta.mp4 asset at the end.

player_character.name: The Traveler
player_character.gender_note: Default to Lumine (female, blonde twin) unless user specifies Aether. Both valid.
player_character.description: The Traveler — golden-haired wanderer from another world. Distinctive star-shaped hair accessory, traveler's outfit. Searching for their lost sibling across Teyvat.
player_character.note: Voice ref must be loaded for Chatterbox. Use Traveller.mp3 from game root if voice-1.mp3 missing.
